summary: Corbin Mountain lookout tower, about 15 m in 1979; the survey file places it in Greenville County, SC, not NC; no build date or current status found.

facts.design: Four-legged standard tower with peaked roof
facts.status_note: The survey file's last note, from 2000, records the station's condition and does not describe the tower.

events.note: The survey file first records the mark in 1979 and calls the structure the Corbin Mountain Lookout Tower.
A recovery note gives road directions to the lookout tower and mentions a sign for it.
A recovery note lists the summit as City of Greenville watershed property.

corrections.why: The survey datasheet lists the state as SC and the county as Greenville, and the Forest Lookouts page lists South Carolina - Greenville County.
Same error as region. The survey file puts the mark in South Carolina.
Same error as region. The survey file puts the mark in Greenville County.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NC tower list gives Henderson County for the same coordinates and mark as the survey file, which lists Greenville County, SC. The story follows the survey file and the Forest Lookouts page.
A 1979 description places the tower on the state line. A 1992 recovery note places the summit 0.1 mile south of the line, in South Carolina. The story reports both.

sources.title: NGS Datasheet for FB2902 (CORBIN MTN LOT)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three sources, none gives a build date, builder, staffing or current condition. The brief's region NC, Henderson County is contradicted by the NGS datasheet (SC/GREENVILLE, same coordinates as the NC list) and by the Forest Lookouts page, so the region and local_unit corrections are proposed. The record id still says NC. The NGS HISTORY lines mark the survey station GOOD in 1984, 1992 and 2000, which is about the survey mark, not the tower. Two web searches found nothing else on this tower.
